messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=redwood-inference:inference-proxy, alert=latency_p99_above_threshold, region=us-west-2, p95=220ms, p99=1200ms (>1000ms), window=5m. PD: P12345.
maya: acked the page. I'm on it.
jordan: pinging dashboards now — looking at trace heatmap.
maya: thanks. initial check: autoscaler shows normal activity, but a few nodes show high GPU mem and stuck evictions.
priya: can you paste the runbook steps?
maya: runbook snippet: 
```
1) check kvcache hit rates
2) verify hotkey throttling
3) inspect sidecar queue length on inference-proxy
4) if node mem > 90% -> cordon + trigger drain/replace
```
leo: kvcache hit-rate on affected pool down to 62% (baseline 88%). hotkey count spike on model=gpt-medium-v2.
jordan: logs show repeated OOM-like GC on worker-3: 
```
2023-11-05T14:12:01Z WARN kv-cache: evict failed, mem pressure high
2023-11-05T14:12:03Z ERROR worker-3: KV cache overflow, dropping requests
```
maya: starting a graceful restart of worker-3 now. will route traffic away via fallback policy.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: P12345 status=acknowledged by maya.
priya: routing change applied: inference-proxy -> fallback model variant (gpt-medium-quant) for 10% traffic.
jordan: continuing traces — tail latency concentrated on sequences >1024 tokens. Looks like cache misses + long model forward times.
leo: scaling suggestion: spin up 2 extra pool nodes with larger kvcache size, and increase prefix cache retention for hotkeys. proposing a manual scale while autoscaler catches up.
maya: agreed. starting scale up (k8s scale command): `kubectl scale deploy/inference-pool --replicas=18 -n production`.
maya: worker-3 restart complete, health checks passing. p99 dropped from 1200ms -> 750ms in next minute.
incident-bot: Alert metrics: p95=200ms p99=760ms after routing + restart.
priya: customer impact: small subset of heavy prompt users experienced >1s responses. no 5xx spikes. Estimated affected sessions ~0.7% of requests in the window.
jordan: adding temporary throttle for hotkey prefixes to protect tail latency: `features/kv_hotkey_throttle = true` (rolling config).
leo: applying config now. will monitor.
maya: handing off to night oncall @jordan in 20 minutes. leaving notes in PD for escalation.
jordan: taking handoff. will keep watch for 1 hour, then hand back if stable.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 update: status=resolved by maya -> assigned to jordan for follow-up.
priya: follow-up actions: 1) root-cause: kvcache pressure from hotkey spike, 2) create alert for kv hit-rate drops, 3) IR ticket for model quantization/prefix caching improvements.
maya: will open tickets and assign. thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
jordan: quick postmortem note: consider adding automatic fallback to quant model when p99 > 900ms.
leo: noted, I'll prototype an autoscale policy for hotkey bursts.
maya: closing thread here, monitoring channel for any regressions.
